output: Scientific Hypothesis: Introduction pathways interact with minimum residence time (mrt) to influence the success of non-native plant species in Catalonia. Specifically, species introduced unintentionally tend to have a higher invaded niche breadth compared to those introduced through the AgriForest pathway, while species introduced through the Gardening pathway have a lower invaded niche breadth. This relationship is statistically significant, as indicated by the regression coefficients (mrt: 0.0024924, intro.pathway_Gardening: -0.11809349, intro.pathway_Unintentional: 0.13294556).
